title: Iterate a full-domain broadcaster without assuming every intermediate state stays in the promise
statement: The actual completed review accepts a familywise finite-outcome entanglement-breaking reconstruction bounde<=min(1,ell b+2[sqrt(E/R)+E/R]+d(R)^2/2^ell)from a full-domain normalCPTPbinary broadcaster with marginal errorb, fixed nonnegative Hamiltonian and known zero-energy reset. The square-root cutoff and full-domain iteration remain essential.
